quarterly_data.quarter: Bristol Myers Squibb press release: Bristol Myers Squibb Presents Data Up to Five Years (08-29-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Long-term data presented at ESC Congress 2026 from the EXPLORER-LTE cohort of the MAVA-LTE study (231 patients who completed EXPLORER-HCM) of Camzyos (mavacamten) in symptomatic obstructive HCM: at 252 weeks mean changes from the extension baseline were -38.7 mm Hg in resting LVOT gradient and -55.6 mm Hg in Valsalva LVOT gradient; 97.4% of patients reached a Valsalva LVOT gradient of 30 mm Hg or less, 69.6% improved by at least one NYHA class and 59.2% were asymptomatic, while mean LVEF fell by 10.2% and remained in the normal range, with no new safety signals. Real-world data (COLLIGO-HCM, a German registry) were also presented.
quarterly_data.figure: at 252 weeks: Valsalva LVOT gradient -55.6 mm Hg; 97.4% at or below 30 mm Hg; 69.6% improved >=1 NYHA class
